emails.subject: Draft Solstice agreement
emails.body:
Hi,

Attached is the current authoring of the Solstice engagement documents. Legal flagged a couple of clauses but asked the commercial team to keep these in the loop for timeline visibility. Please hold on external distribution until legal signs off, but sharing internally is OK.

Key points:
- Commercial terms are draft
- Counterparty line items pending

Regards,
Helen
Commercial Operations
BioMed Systems

attachments.content:
Solstice Master Service Agreement - draft

This Master Service Agreement (MSA) is provided as a draft for internal review only. It contains provisional commercial terms, schedules, and redlines. Do not distribute externally until Legal issues final approval.

Sections:
1. Scope
2. Fees
3. Confidentiality
4. Termination

master service agreement
